title: Technical Business Analyst (System Analyst)-40-45k
description:
The role focuses on gathering business requirements and producing clear, structured documentation to support enterprise‑level system and product initiatives. It suits candidates with strong analytical and documentation skills who can bridge business and technical teams within a global financial institution.
Client Details
Our client is with a large organization in the insurance industry, known for its strong presence and commitment to delivering innovative solutions. The company operates in Wong Chuk Hang and is focused on leveraging technology to drive business growth and operational efficiency.
Description
Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams to collect, analyze, and validate business requirements.
Translate workflow processes into clear and structured documentation, including process flows, user journeys, functional specifications, and system integration artefacts.
Leverage AI tools and prompting techniques to enhance documentation quality, accuracy, and efficiency across project deliverables.
Support the creation of large-scale documentation for system enhancements, product changes, and technology transformation initiatives.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure business requirements are accurately captured and aligned with system capabilities.
Assist in solution discussions by providing insights on workflow optimization and documentation best practices.
Participate in upcoming General Insurance (GI) product initiatives and coordinate with internal teams and external vendors when required.
Ensure that documentation standards, governance, and review processes are consistently met throughout project cycles.
Profile
3-10 years of experience in Technical Business Analysis, System Analysis, or related IT/business roles.
Background as a developer earlier in career is preferred, with subsequent transition into system analysis or business analysis.
Strong experience producing large-scale, structured, and professional documentation for enterprise-level projects.
Hands-on user of AI tools (e.g., AI-assisted documentation, prompting, workflow automation) with proven ability to apply AI to improve productivity and documentation quality.
Solid understanding of workflow analysis, process mapping, and requirement-gathering methodologies.
Experience from big firms, SI vendors, or financial services (FS) environments is highly desirable.
Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with multiple concurrent initiatives.
Job Offer
Competitive monthly salary and benefits.
Work in a large organization within the insurance industry, located in Wong Chuk Hang.
Collaborative work environment that values innovation and expertise.

title: AI Data Project Specialist (One-Year Contract)
description:
Summary
As an AI Data Project Specialist (One-Year Contract), you will be responsible for data labelling, quality checking, summarizing and communicating data findings, client communication, and supporting the Data Manager in delivering data projects that are essential to our AI products and customer success. You will work in an energetic team and manage part-time or vendors for project delivery. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, responsible, and capable of working independently at the client’s site.
Contract Term
This is a one-year contract position from 15 June 2026 to 14 June 2027. The exact start and end dates may be adjusted within a reasonable range, subject to mutual agreement.
Responsibilities
As a Supervisor of 1-3 Data Labellers:
1. Work independently at the client’s site in a supervisory and task management capacity for data labelling and quality checking, ensuring that data meets the target accuracy rate and project timeline.
2. Train part-time teams on data labelling guidelines and the use of data labelling tools.
3. Communicate with clients on behalf of the data project team.
4. Summarize and share findings from work conducted at the client site with the Data Team and Research Team to help improve our AI products.
As a Data Labeller and Checker:
1. Conduct hands-on data labelling and quality checking to ensure that labelled data meets the target accuracy rate.
As a Data Project Assistant:
1. Assist the Data Manager in recruiting part-time or sourcing vendors for data labelling, data creation, and data sourcing projects.
2. Assist the Data Manager in delivering data labelling, data creation, and data sourcing projects with high quality, on time, and within budget.
Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree or above.
2. Native Cantonese speaker, with good command of written and spoken Cantonese, English, and Mandarin.
3. At least 1 year of work experience, preferably in the technology industry and ideally with companies that provide data sourcing or data annotation services for speech recognition technologies.
4. Willingness to work at the client’s site as needed (estimated at 30% or more of time at the client’s site across a year).
5. Good communication skills.
6. Quick learner, open to new concepts and technologies, and willing to learn.
7. Self-motivated and willing to take on new responsibilities with a growth mindset.
8. Detail-oriented.
9. Able to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Competencies
1. Ownership: Takes responsibility for tasks and outcomes.
2. Reliability: Dependable and consistent in meeting commitments.
3. Commitment to Quality: Focused on delivering work with high quality and attention to detail.
4. Deliver Results: Consistently achieves goals and objectives.
5. Integrity: Upholds ethical principles and honesty in all actions.
What We Offer
1. Hybrid work arrangement (in-office and work-from-home) when not required to work at the client’s site.
2. Competitive compensation package.
3. Transparency, trust, and ownership.
4. Exposure to growth opportunities in a fast-growing B2B AI software company.
Application Note
Please use "ADC_" as the prefix in your resume's filename. For example, if your resume's filename is "Resume_First Name Surname", please modify it to "ADC_Resume_First Name Surname".

title: Software Engineer
description:
ViuTV is seeking a passionate and highly skilled Full Stack Software Engineer to join our digital team. The Software Engineer will be responsible for developing and maintaining our digital products, including web applications, mobile apps, and smart TV solutions, as well as our backend and data infrastructure.
Your New Role:
Development
: Develop and maintain our Apps, Websites, TV Apps, backend API and data infrastructure.
Quality
: Write clean, maintainable and testable code. Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.
Problem solving
: Troubleshoot and debug issues that arise.
Documentation
: Maintain detailed documentation, including API document, system architecture and design diagram, release note, etc.
Collaboration
: Collaborate closely with product managers, designers and QA engineers to ensure smooth product delivery.
Evolving
: Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies. Embrace continuous learning.
What makes you succeed:
Education & Experience:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
Technical Core:
Deep proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js, with specialized expertise in React and React Native.
Data:
Hands-on experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, database management (MongoDB, MySQL)
Infrastructure:
Cloud ecosystems like AWS, GCP, Azure, Alibaba Cloud, etc.
Industry Edge:
Strong interest or experience in video streaming technologies (e.g. HLS, DASH) and the digital advertising landscape.
Workflow
: Familiar with Agile/Scrum environments and standard collaboration tools like Jira and Git.
Soft Skills:
Exceptional problem-solving abilities and the communication skills necessary to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced team.
Fluency in Cantonese and the ability to read and write Traditional Chinese are essential for effective communication and documentation.
This position requires the candidate to work closely with our team in Hong Kong. On-site collaboration is essential.
Fresh graduates with a passion for the software engineering field are welcome to apply. More experienced candidates may be considered for the position of Senior Software Engineer.
We offer attractive & competitive salary and benefits, an exciting work environment and excellent career development opportunities. If you have the desire for an exciting and rewarding career, please click Apply or send your resume to
career-media@pccw.com
, stating your present and expected salary.
